basis: Generic neutral baseline for the synthetic walkthrough only; not derived from personal samples and not evidence of any user's approval or learned voice.
sentence_length: Prefer clear sentences of roughly 15–25 words; keep necessary technical qualifiers.
directness: Lead with the action or main point, followed by concrete implementation detail.
paragraphs: One main idea per cover-letter paragraph, usually two or three sentences; concise resume bullets.
technical_detail: Describe actual tool use and supported outcomes rather than listing keywords.
confidence: Be specific about confirmed work; retain estimates, uncertainty and ownership boundaries.
calibration_status: Generic demonstration; no personal voice matching claimed.
